brand.tagline: Parts that keep the line turning.
brand.mission: Deliver committed machinery parts reliably and on time so plants and workshops trust FerrousWorks enough to keep production lines scheduled without a backstop.
brand.vision: Industrial machinery where the part you ordered arrives exactly when the maintenance plan said — so uptime is planned, not hoped for.
values: A late part is a stopped line; we protect the schedule.
On time never trades off tolerances or metallurgy.
Every part lot is ledger-verified from material to machine.
Planners lean on us to keep lines running.
We make parts that outlast the maintenance cycle.
brand.about: FerrousWorks is an industrial machinery-parts supplier. We take committed machinery parts deliveries and land them on the date the production plan needs them — machined, verified, traceable. In a plant where a missed part means a quiet line and idle labour, our on-time evidence is what lets planners schedule with confidence instead of contingency.
fast_facts: Serving plants, OEMs, and job shops
history: Founded as a machine shop in the industrial Midwest.
Digitised every lot to ledger-verified on-time evidence.
leadership: Metallurgist and shop floor leader before taking the helm of FerrousWorks.
Owns machining capacity and the on-time gate.
testimonials: FerrousWorks is the one supplier our maintenance schedule doesn't hedge against.
brand.locations: Cleveland, OH (HQ) · machining plants serving the industrial Midwest and beyond
faq: How is your on-time claim verified?
Each committed part lot anchors to a signed ledger event with a verified delivery time — traceable from material order to the plant.
Do you support emergency and planned maintenance parts?
Yes, both; every committed delivery, planned or rush, runs under the same on-time gate.
brand.careers: Keep the line turning: machining, metallurgy, supply, quality, planning.
brand.investors: Privately held. Plant reliability data shared on request.
brand.esg: Low-waste machining, material traceability for circularity, apprentice and upskilling programs.
